request: Create a planted-rice paddy terrain atlas that follows the existing crop-field tile style and format.

immutable.frame_order: (0,0), (1,0), (0,1), (1,1); each is a static terrain variation, not an animation frame
immutable.ground_landmarks: Each cell fills the whole tile; horizontal tilled-soil row direction remains consistent.

allowed_changes: add shallow teal water between planting rows
vary seedling positions among the four cells
identity_to_preserve: pixel-art cluster scale and sharp edges
full-bleed terrain tile without border or transparent gaps
palette_mode: preserve_soil_material_tonal_roles; add rice greens and shallow-water teals from reports/art-direction/kingdom-palette.gpl
validation_note: The bundled analyser was not applicable to the opaque static tile (no background to segment, no animation sequence). Exact canvas/grid, opacity, four unique cells, palette use, and seamless edges were measured separately; visual review passed.
